description.zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
性能监控指标，允许一次传入多个指标进行查询，多个指标参数间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
> 更多关于性能监控指标详情，请参见[存储监控](~~186705~~)。
description.en:
The performance monitoring metrics. You can specify multiple metrics in a single request. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,).
> For more information about performance monitoring metrics, see [Storage monitoring](~~186705~~).
The instance ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance at the storage layer.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

title.zh: 查询存储层RDS性能数据详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds describe-rds-performance --drds-instance-id drds000000000 --rds-instance-id rm-000000000000 --keys MySQL_MemCpuUsage --start-time 1603123290000 --end-time 1603209690000 --db-inst-type mysql --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds DescribeRDSPerformance --region cn-hangzhou --DbInstType mysql --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000 --EndTime 1603209690000 --Keys MySQL_MemCpuUsage --StartTime 1603123290000 --RdsInstanceId 'rm-000000000000'
